summary: Tested iteration 3 changes end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass (loan_target routing to team/person, return reverses the correct debt, GET /teams/{id} returns {team,people,history}, GET /users includes online+last_login, login_history tracked on login/logout, admin-only history endpoint). Frontend: Loans dialog has new target toggle (Person/Lag) with correct dark-green styling + testids; Users page shows online dot, 'Pålogget' badge, 'Siste pålogging' column + history dialog (table columns: Pålogget / Avlogget / Varighet). CRITICAL frontend regression on Teams.jsx: the view-team detail dialog AND the team quick-loan dialog are NOT rendered. Teams.jsx declares `detail` and `loanFor` React state and the open-functions (`showDetail`, `openQuickLoan`, `submitQuickLoan`) but the file contains ONLY the create/edit dialog JSX - no <Dialog open={!!detail}> block and no <Dialog open={!!loanFor}> block. Clicking eye icon or 'Lån ut' on /app/lag therefore does nothing visible. All associated testids (quick-loan-team-item, quick-loan-team-qty, submit-quick-loan-team) are also missing.

minor.issue: A new login_history record is created on each login without closing the previous open (logged_out_at==null) record for the same user. UI shows multiple 'Fortsatt aktiv' sessions for the same user. Consider closing stale open sessions on new login.

ui_bugs.issue: Eye icon (view-team-{id}) sets state `detail` but no Dialog component renders it - the detail dialog JSX is missing entirely. User sees no feedback when clicking eye.

'Lån ut' button (quick-loan-team-{id}) sets state `loanFor` but no Dialog component renders it - the quick-loan dialog JSX is missing entirely. Required testids quick-loan-team-item / quick-loan-team-qty / submit-quick-loan-team are absent in DOM.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be exercised from UI because the dialog is not rendered. Backend path works - verified via pytest.

action_items: Add the missing <Dialog open={!!detail} onOpenChange={() => setDetail(null)}> block to Teams.jsx rendering team name, debt, people table, and loan history table using the {team, people, history} response.

Add the missing <Dialog open={!!loanFor} onOpenChange={() => setLoanFor(null)}> block to Teams.jsx with item Select (data-testid=quick-loan-team-item), quantity Input (data-testid=quick-loan-team-qty), and submit button calling submitQuickLoan (data-testid=submit-quick-loan-team).
(Optional) On login, close any open login_history for the user before inserting the new record to avoid accumulating 'Fortsatt aktiv' entries.
critical_code_review_comments: Teams.jsx carries dead state (`detail`, `loanFor`, `loanForm`, `selectedItem`, `submitQuickLoan`) with no rendering — likely truncated during edit. ESLint rule react/jsx-no-undef wouldn't catch this; add a smoke test or storybook snapshot per page.
server.py login handler creates login_history on every login; no cleanup for abandoned sessions can grow unbounded. Consider TTL index or close-on-new-login logic.
server.py get_current_user heartbeat updates last_seen on every authenticated request (write-amplification); may be acceptable but worth noting for high-traffic tenants.
seed_data_creation: pytest creates a TEST_It3_* tenant via /api/signup, upgrades to deluxe, exercises CRUD. Soft-deleted on teardown. People/items/teams/loans created inside tenant are left in place but prefixed TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent adds the two missing Dialogs in Teams.jsx, retest: (1) click view-team-{id} → dialog shows team name, debt, people-table (name/phone/debt), history-table (date, item, qty, status); (2) click quick-loan-team-{id} → dialog opens with team pre-filled, fill item+qty+submit; verify GET /api/teams returns team.debt increased and GET /api/people shows no debt change (loan_target='team' already works at backend).
rca of the issue: Teams.jsx was partially implemented: handler functions `showDetail` and `openQuickLoan` set React state, but the corresponding <Dialog> JSX was never added to the component return tree. Verified by grepping Dialog usage: only the create/edit Dialog (lines 183-243) exists. State mutations therefore have no visual effect. Mitigation: main agent must add the two Dialog blocks using the already-fetched {team, people, history} structure and the loanForm state.
